Express is part of 8 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2016.

What it was for: [Web](@/projects/web.md) (3), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2), [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1) and [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [gooddata-proxy](@/work/gooddata-proxy.md): GoodData Proxy; [node-proxy-upload](@/work/node-proxy-upload.md): Simple example how to upload multipart files via node http proxy; [docker-conf2015](@/work/docker-conf2015.md): Dockerfile for GD ConferenceDay 2015.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Express: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Express to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
